blocks.text: MEMPHIS, Tennessee — Memphis Grizzlies forward GG Jackson has a broken bone in his left foot that will require surgery. The Grizzlies announced Monday that Jackson had broken the fifth metatarsal in his left foot during the first quarter of a 129-110 victory over the Brooklyn Nets on Saturday. The Grizzlies said they would announce a timeline for Jackson’s return after the surgery.
